title: Typed Multi-Packet Hydrology Provider and Forcing Lifecycle

checks: KT11 authority and evidence blob identity guards
compiled KT11 provider and lifecycle harness

candidate_claim: An immutable collection of complete KT05 explicit hydrology packets can deterministically select exactly one packet from a bounded whole-day KT02 requested interval, remain stateless across repeated requests, fail closed on missing or duplicate interval keys, and delegate the selected packet through admitted KT06 without changing KT02 time, accepted-state or publication ownership.
qualified_technical_evidence: exact endpoint plus duration interval key
duplicate exact key rejected at initialization
equal endpoint with different durations remains distinct interval keys
storage order has no semantic effect
provider owns deep copies of caller packets
invalid provider reports not-ready and zero usable packet count
no mutable selection cursor or consume-on-read state
repeat selection of same interval is stable
missing middle packet cannot externally publish partial KT02 interval
eight representative real LWKM packets bind through provider and frozen KT06
KT08 1800-packet temporal summary remains supplemental B1 evidence only
explicit_exclusions: dynamic streaming or mutable provider lifecycle
